section_summary.extract_value: This section details the descriptive information and data preparation for an analysis comparing heterosexual men (n=301) and sexual minority men (n=131). It notes that some analyses were restricted to heterosexual men due to low Cronbach's alphas among sexual minority men for certain measures. The section also addresses missing data, stating that 31.63% of participants (n=149) had missing data, and describes the use of multiple imputation to complete the dataset.
